# Supplied fictional evidence

Primary policy snapshot dated 2026-10-01: the current edition permits four loans. The archived 2025 edition permitted two. The project uses the current edition.

## Supplier snapshots

The current cabinet specification says indoor use only; an older outdoor model was weatherproof. The current model is identified separately in the applicability note.

## Original study and correction

The original reminder study found an association with attendance. Its correction says the observational method does not establish causation. A summary copies the same study; it is not independent evidence.

System Cedar supports offline work and CSV export. System Elm requires a connection and exports JSON. Cabinet Ash holds 40 units indoors; cabinet Birch holds 20 outdoors. Reminder options are printed cards and text messages. Prices are not supplied. These are captured records, not live trials.
